record.label: One run of phase estimation from an eigenstate
record.statement: The resource estimate is for one phase-estimation run on a supplied eigenstate. Trial-state preparation and repeated runs are additional costs.
record.boundary: On a trial state $|\phi\rangle$, the phase-estimation distribution is a mixture of the eigenstate distributions with weights $|\langle\psi_j|\phi\rangle|^2$. Appendix I.1 counts one run on a supplied eigenstate. It treats preparing the trial state and repeating phase estimation to sample the ground-state component as separate costs.
